name: Space Shuttle Digital Computer Simulation Benchmark
description: A simulation workload/benchmark based on the Space Shuttle digital computer intended to evaluate computer simulation performance and behavior.
reputation: A specialized, historical simulation benchmark used in real-time and aerospace simulation research but not widely adopted in modern ML benchmarking.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on simulation fidelity and runtime; hardware- and implementation-dependent, small/older workload, potential portability issues across platforms.
